user.title: Configure Telegraf MQTT
user.description: Choose how to set up the MQTT topic pattern.

manual_topic.title: Configure Telegraf MQTT
manual_topic.description: Enter the MQTT topic pattern you want to subscribe to. Entities will be auto-detected from traffic under this pattern.

scan_settings.title: Discover topics
scan_settings.description: The integration will listen to the broker for a short window and show you the topic prefixes it saw. You pick which one to subscribe to. Topic discovery only happens during setup -- it does not stay running.

pick_topics.title: Pick a topic to subscribe to
pick_topics.description: These are the topic prefixes the broker carried during the scan. A Telegraf-shaped one is pre-selected; keep it or pick another, or type a custom pattern. Each entry subscribes to exactly one pattern -- add another entry to cover more topic roots. Topic-level isolation is preserved -- the integration will not silently widen past the prefix you choose.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Telegraf MQTT
reconfigure.description: Update the MQTT subscription, device name, or device metadata. The integration will reload to apply changes.

data_description.exclude_patterns: Glob patterns matched against each metric's unique key; matching metrics are hidden and marked unavailable.
data_description.category_overrides: Map of metric unique keys -- or glob patterns like mem_* -- to config, diagnostic, or null. An exact key always wins over a glob; the first matching glob in definition order is used.
data_description.auto_discover: Run a second MQTT subscription that feeds newly-seen Telegraf hosts into this entry so they appear without adding another config entry. Off by default.
data_description.auto_discover_scope: The MQTT filter the auto-discover subscription listens on. It is independent of this entry's topic pattern and may be broader, so any host publishing under it becomes a device. Messages already covered by the topic pattern are skipped, so only genuinely new hosts are added. On a broker shared with other systems this is an access-relevant subscription: choose a scope no broader than you intend this entry to consume.
data_description.device_id_strategy: How one Home Assistant device per Telegraf host is identified. "Host tag" trusts the host tag in the payload. "Host tag, then topic segment" falls back to the second topic level when the host tag is a default like localhost. "Topic tree only" ignores the host tag entirely.
data_description.field_overrides: Per-field overrides keyed by field name. Each entry may set platform (auto, sensor, binary_sensor or none), native_unit, device_class and state_class.
data_description.expire_after: Seconds without an update before a metric is reported as unavailable. Defaults to 120; Telegraf's own default publish interval is 10-60s, so keep this above it.
data_description.enable_cleanup: Automatically remove entities and whole devices that stop reporting. When off, nothing is ever deleted -- metrics only go unavailable.
data_description.cleanup_delay: Seconds a stale metric must stay stale, on a host that is still reporting, before its entity is removed. Defaults to 30 days.
data_description.delete_delay: Seconds a whole host must stay completely silent before its device and all of its entities are removed. This is what stops a departed host from occupying a device slot forever. Defaults to 60 days.
data_description.min_active_metrics: Never strip a device below this many currently-available metrics. Prevents a host from losing every entity while it is still partly reporting.

scan_running.title: Discovering topics
scan_running.description: Listening to {probe} for {duration} seconds. Newly seen topics will be collected when the scan completes.

error.invalid_topic: Enter a valid MQTT subscription topic.
error.invalid_duration: Enter a duration between 5 and 300 seconds.
error.no_traffic_on_scan_root: No traffic was seen on the scan root topic during the scan window. Try a wider scan root (e.g. telegraf/#) or run the scan again when more devices are publishing.
error.no_topics_selected: Pick a topic prefix to subscribe to.
error.scan_failed: The broker refused the scan subscription, so no topics could be discovered. Check that the broker is reachable and that this integration is allowed to subscribe to that topic.
error.cannot_connect: The broker refused the subscription on this topic, so the new topic pattern was not saved. The previous pattern is still active. Check that the broker is reachable and that this integration is allowed to subscribe to that topic.

abort.already_configured: This topic pattern is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The entry was reconfigured and reloaded with the new settings.
abort.cannot_connect: The new MQTT topic pattern could not be subscribed to, so nothing was changed.

progress.scan_running: Listening to {probe} for {duration} seconds. Newly seen topics will be collected when the scan completes.

overlap_topic_patterns.title: Overlapping topic patterns
overlap_topic_patterns.description: This Telegraf MQTT entry's topic pattern "{own_topic}" overlaps with another entry "{other_entry_title}" whose pattern is "{other_topic}". The same MQTT messages will be processed by both entries, producing duplicate entities. Change one of the patterns so they cover distinct message streams.

invalid_persisted_option.title: Invalid Telegraf MQTT option(s)
invalid_persisted_option.description: The persisted value for {options} is invalid. The integration fell back to default values ({defaults}) so setup could complete. Open the integration's options dialog and correct the values, or remove and re-add the entry to reset the options to defaults.

device_cap_reached.title: Telegraf MQTT device cap reached
device_cap_reached.description: This entry has dropped {dropped} measurements from new Telegraf hosts because the device cap ({max_devices}) was reached. New hosts under "{configured_topic}" are being ignored. Add another config entry with a narrower topic pattern to split the load, or consolidate hosts.

metric_cap_reached.title: Telegraf MQTT metric cap reached
metric_cap_reached.description: This entry has dropped {dropped} new metrics because the per-device metric cap ({max_metrics_per_device}) was reached on at least one device. Metrics beyond the cap are being ignored for "{configured_topic}".

no_traffic_on_topic.title: No Telegraf traffic on the configured topic
no_traffic_on_topic.description: No message has arrived on the MQTT topic pattern "{configured_topic}" since this entry was set up. Seen topics so far: {seen_topics}. Check that Telegraf is configured to publish line-protocol-over-JSON to that topic, that the topic pattern in this entry matches, and that the broker's ACLs allow this integration to subscribe to it.

device_id_collision.title: Telegraf host tags collapsed onto one device
device_id_collision.description: These host tags produced the same device id and were merged into a single device: {description}. This is usually Telegraf's default host value (for example "localhost" or the container id) being inherited by more than one agent. Set a distinct `hostname` in each Telegraf agent's `[agent]` config, or switch this entry's device id strategy to "Host tag, then topic segment" so the topic tree disambiguates them.

device_id_conflict.title: Two Telegraf MQTT entries produce the same device
device_id_conflict.description: More than one config entry is reporting the same device id: {conflicts}. Their entities will be merged onto one device in Home Assistant. Adjust one entry's topic pattern, or its device id strategy, so each entry covers a distinct set of hosts.

auto_discover_scope_redundant.title: Auto-discover scope adds nothing
auto_discover_scope_redundant.description: Auto-discover is on with the scope "{auto_discover_scope}", but this entry's topic pattern "{configured_topic}" already covers all of it -- so every message the extra subscription receives is skipped as a duplicate and no new host can ever be discovered. Either widen the auto-discover scope to include topics this entry does not already cover, or turn auto-discover off.

reconfigure_subscribe_failed.message: Could not subscribe to the new MQTT topic pattern {topic}: {error}. The integration kept the previous subscription.

mqtt_broker_unreachable.message: Could not reach the MQTT broker to subscribe to {topic}: {error}. Home Assistant will keep retrying.

missing_topic_pattern.message: The entry "{entry_title}" has no MQTT topic pattern stored, so it cannot start. Reconfigure the entry and set a topic pattern, or remove and re-add it.
